transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Nice to meet you too. Um, mostly I’m here because I’m just really tired. But it's in a way that sleep doesn’t really fix. Even doing normal, everyday things, like unloading the dishwasher or trying to read for my certificate class... it just feels like too much right now.
After you do something physical or mental, do you feel significantly worse afterward?

Um, no, I don't think so. I wouldn't say I feel worse afterward. It's more just... I'm already so drained before I even start. Doing the task doesn't really make me crash or anything, it's just really hard to find the energy to actually get through it in the first place.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Not really, no. I wouldn't say I feel sad or depressed. I don't feel down in the dumps or anything like that. It's really just the exhaustion. I just don't have the energy to do much, but my mood itself isn't really sad, if that makes sense.
Have you been feeling unusually worried or anxious lately?

Um, no, not really. I haven't noticed feeling particularly anxious or worried about anything. My mind isn't racing or anything like that. I don't feel on edge... it really all just comes back to feeling so drained.
Have you been feeling unusually sensitive to cold?
No, I don't think so. I haven't noticed feeling any colder than usual. Just... normal, I guess. I haven't needed to put on extra layers or turn up the heat or anything like that.
Have you been constipated lately?
No, my stomach's been fine. I haven't had any issues with going to the bathroom or anything like that. Everything seems pretty normal on that front.
Have you noticed any recent weight gain?

No, not weight gain. Actually, it's kind of the opposite. My appetite has been pretty off lately. I'll... sometimes I just realize I’ve only had coffee and maybe a few bites of food all day long. So my jeans have actually gotten looser, and I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I just... I stopped caring about the things that usually make me feel like myself. Like, I haven't been sketching or going to gallery openings at all. I usually enjoy cooking and doing yoga, or even just playing tennis with a friend, but lately... I just don't really have any interest in doing any of it.
Even if you don’t feel exactly sad, have you been feeling emotionally down or empty lately?
No, not really. I don't feel sad or... empty. It's just like I was saying before about not having any interest in my hobbies. But I haven't really been feeling emotionally down or anything like that.
Have you been waking up much earlier than usual and then not able to fall back asleep?
No, not really. I usually just wake up around my normal time. I haven't had any issues with waking up super early or... not being able to go back to sleep.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah, I have. It's like... I just have a hard time focusing enough to make a decision on what to do next. I’ll sit there with my planning app open, and I still won't be able to decide whether I should work on a class assignment, pay a bill, or just start making dinner. I get kind of stuck... so I end up doing none of it for a while.
Have you ever had another period like this before?
No, I don't think so. I mean... I've never really felt this stuck before. So, no, I haven't had another period quite like this.
Have you been feeling worthless or excessively guilty lately?
No, not really. I mean, I don't feel worthless or anything like that. And I haven't been feeling guilty either. Just... stuck, like I said.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I'd say... it's been about three months. This whole quieter, depressed stretch, where I just have really low interest in things and a lot of heavy fatigue, has been going on for about that long.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't. I mean, I feel tired and unmotivated, but I don't want to die or anything like that. I've never thought about hurting myself.
